job_title.description: Accepts an array of job titles. (array, max:50)

past_job_title.description: Returns profiles that held these job titles in past (non-current) roles. Cannot be combined with current_titles_only: false. Cannot be combined with match_experience when both job_title and company are set. (array, max:50)

job_function.description: Accepts an array of job functions to filter profiles by their functional area (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance). Accepted values list (array, max:50)

seniority.description: Accepts an array of seniority levels to filter profiles by their career level. Accepted values list (array, max:50)

current_titles_only.description: Returns profiles matching the current job title. If specified false, the response will return profiles matching the current or past job title. (boolean, default: true)

include_related_job_titles.description: Returns profiles with related job titles (boolean, default: false)

match_experience.description: Ensures job_title and company match in the same experience. current – Returns profiles that match the current experience.past – Returns profiles that match any past experience.both – Returns profiles matching either current or past experience.If set, current_titles_only and company_filter should not be used; otherwise, an error is returned. (string, default: current)

skills.description: Accepts an array of skills (array, max:50)

languages.description: Accepts an array of language objects. Each object must have a language field (required string) and optionally a proficiency field (array of strings). If proficiency is not provided, any proficiency level is accepted. Accepted values list for proficiency. (array, max:50)

education.description: Accepts an array of schools/degrees (array, max:50)

educations.description: Accepts an array of education objects. Each object can have optional fields: school_name (string), field_of_study (string), and location (string). At least one field must be provided. (array, max:50)

location.description: Accepts an array of locations (array, max:50)

location_radius.description: Search radius in miles (1-500). Only works when location is provided and the location is a city / area. Filters profiles within the specified radius of the location. (integer)

current_work_location.description: Accepts an array of location strings (cities or countries). Filters profiles who currently work in any of the specified locations. (array, max:50)

past_work_location.description: Accepts an array of location strings (cities or countries). Filters profiles who previously worked in any of the specified locations. (array, max:50)

company.description: Accepts an array of company names (array, max:50)

past_company.description: Returns profiles that worked at these companies in past (non-current) roles. Cannot be combined with company_filter set to past, past_only, or both. Cannot be combined with match_experience when both job_title and company are set. (array, max:50)

company_filter.description: current – Returns profiles matching the current company name    past – Returns profiles matching any past company name  past_only – Returns profiles where the company appears in past experience and is not their current employer.  both – Returns profiles matching either current or past experience (string, default: current)

current_company_only.description: Returns profiles matching the current company name (boolean, default: true)

domain.description: Accepts an array of domains (array, max:50)

industry.description: Accepts an array of industries. Prefix an industry with NOT to exclude it (e.g. "NOT Computer Software"). Accepted values list (array, max:50)

keyword.description: Returns profiles that contain the mentioned keyword anywhere in their profile (text)

company_size.description: Accepts an array of company size ranges. Accepted values list (array)

years_of_experience.description: Accepts an array of ranges in the format X_Y where X and Y are integers representing the minimum and maximum years of experience. e.g. ["2_5", "6_10"] means 2-5 years OR 6-10 years. (array)

years_in_current_role.description: Accepts an array of ranges in the format X_Y where X and Y are integers representing the minimum and maximum years in current role. e.g. ["1_3", "4_6"] means 1-3 years OR 4-6 years in current role. Cannot be used with recently_changed_jobs. (array)

recently_changed_jobs.description: If set to true, returns profiles whose current job started within the last 3 calendar months. Cannot be used with years_in_current_role. (boolean, default: false)

is_currently_working.description: If true, returns only profiles with an active current role. If false, returns only profiles with no active current role. Omit to return both. (boolean)

page.description: Provides results for the given page (integer)

page_size.description: Maximum number of profiles to return per page. Valid range is 1-25. When not provided, 25 profiles are returned. Search credits are charged only for the number of profiles returned. (integer, default: 25)

data_types.description: Returns profiles containing atleast one of the specified data types. It accepts an array of one more values from this list [personal_email, work_email, phone] (array)

reveal_info.description: If set to true, contact_info will contain the emails and phone numbers of the profile and credits will be charged (boolean, default: false)

detailed_experience.description: If set to true, the experience field returns detailed data like title, company_name, summary, start_date_year, start_date_month, end_date_year, end_date_month, is_current, linkedin_url, logo_url. If false, returns simple text strings. (boolean, default: false)

detailed_education.description: If set to true, the education field returns detailed data like school_name, degree, field_of_study, description, start_date_year, end_date_year, url. If false, returns simple text strings. (boolean, default: false)

exclude_job_titles.description: Accepts an array of job titles to exclude from results. (array)

exclude_companies.description: Accepts an array of company names to exclude from results. (array)

exclude_companies_filter.description: Applies when exclude_companies is non-empty. current – Exclude if the company appears as the profile's current employer only.past – Exclude if it appears in past roles only.both – Exclude if it appears in either current or past experience. (string, default: both)
